cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(nccl_ep LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)
include(GNUInstallDirs)
find_package(CUDAToolkit REQUIRED)
if(NOT CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES)
  set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES 90)
endif()
foreach(arch IN LISTS CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES)
  if(arch LESS 90)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "NCCL-EP requires SM90 or newer")
  endif()
endforeach()

set(NCCL_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Installed NCCL prefix (2.30+)")
find_path(NCCL_INCLUDE_DIR nccl_device.h HINTS ${NCCL_DIR}/include REQUIRED)
find_library(NCCL_LIBRARY NAMES nccl libnccl.so.2 HINTS ${NCCL_DIR}/lib REQUIRED)
if(NOT TARGET nccl)
  add_library(nccl SHARED IMPORTED)
  set_target_properties(nccl PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${NCCL_LIBRARY}"
    INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${NCCL_INCLUDE_DIR}")
endif()
option(NCCL_EP_USE_UCCL_GIN "Use UCCL for HT rail operations" OFF)
option(NCCL_EP_UCCL_EFA "Build the UCCL EFA transport" ON)
option(NCCL_EP_BUILD_EXAMPLES "Build MPI EP test and benchmark" OFF)
set(_NCCL_EP_LSA_TEAM_SIZE_MIN 4 CACHE STRING "Minimum LSA size (1 or multiple of 4)")
set(_NCCL_EP_LSA_TEAM_SIZE_MAX 32 CACHE STRING "Maximum LSA size")
set(_NCCL_EP_NUM_LSA_TEAMS_LIST "1;2;3;4;8" CACHE STRING "Node counts to instantiate")
set(EP_SOURCES nccl_ep.cc device/low_latency.cu device/hybridep_adapter.cu)
if(NCCL_EP_USE_UCCL_GIN)
  get_filename_component(GIN "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../experimental/uccl_gin" ABSOLUTE)
  get_filename_component(UCCL_ROOT "${GIN}/../.." ABSOLUTE)
  find_path(NUMA_INCLUDE_DIR numa.h REQUIRED)
  find_path(VERBS_INCLUDE_DIR infiniband/verbs.h REQUIRED)
  find_path(NL_INCLUDE_DIR netlink/netlink.h PATH_SUFFIXES libnl3 REQUIRED)
  find_library(NUMA_LIBRARY numa REQUIRED)
  find_library(VERBS_LIBRARY ibverbs REQUIRED)
  find_library(NL_LIBRARY nl-3 REQUIRED)
  find_library(NL_ROUTE_LIBRARY nl-route-3 REQUIRED)
  list(APPEND EP_SOURCES adapter/uccl_gin_context.cpp
    ${GIN}/transport/proxy.cpp ${GIN}/transport/rdma.cpp
    ${GIN}/transport/common.cpp ${GIN}/transport/uccl_proxy.cpp
    ${GIN}/transport/fifo.cpp ${GIN}/transport/adaptive_sleeper.cc)
  if(NCCL_EP_UCCL_EFA)
    find_library(EFA_LIBRARY efa REQUIRED)
  endif()
endif()

add_library(nccl_ep_shared SHARED ${EP_SOURCES})
add_library(nccl_ep_static STATIC ${EP_SOURCES})
add_custom_target(nccl_ep_lib DEPENDS nccl_ep_shared nccl_ep_static)
foreach(t nccl_ep_shared nccl_ep_static)
  set_target_properties(${t} PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME nccl_ep
    CXX_STANDARD 17 CUDA_STANDARD 17 POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
  target_include_directories(${t} PUBLIC . include device ${NCCL_INCLUDE_DIR}
    ${CUDAToolkit_INCLUDE_DIRS}/cccl)
  target_link_libraries(${t} PUBLIC nccl CUDA::cudart CUDA::cuda_driver)
  target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:--expt-relaxed-constexpr>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-Xcompiler=-fvisibility=hidden>)
  target_compile_definitions(${t} PRIVATE
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:NCCL_HOSTLIB_ONLY=1>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:NCCL_CHECK_CUDACC=1>
    _NCCL_EP_LSA_TEAM_SIZE_MIN=${_NCCL_EP_LSA_TEAM_SIZE_MIN}
    _NCCL_EP_LSA_TEAM_SIZE_MAX=${_NCCL_EP_LSA_TEAM_SIZE_MAX})
  foreach(n IN LISTS _NCCL_EP_NUM_LSA_TEAMS_LIST)
    target_compile_definitions(${t} PRIVATE _NCCL_EP_NUM_LSA_TEAMS_${n}=1)
  endforeach()
  if(NCCL_EP_USE_UCCL_GIN)
    target_compile_definitions(${t} PUBLIC NCCL_EP_USE_UCCL_GIN=1 UCCL_GIN_WITH_NCCL_GIN=1)
    target_include_directories(${t} PUBLIC ${GIN} ${UCCL_ROOT}/include
      ${NUMA_INCLUDE_DIR} ${VERBS_INCLUDE_DIR} ${NL_INCLUDE_DIR})
    target_link_libraries(${t} PRIVATE ${NUMA_LIBRARY} ${VERBS_LIBRARY}
      ${NL_LIBRARY} ${NL_ROUTE_LIBRARY} pthread)
    if(NCCL_EP_UCCL_EFA)
      target_compile_definitions(${t} PRIVATE EFA=1)
      target_link_libraries(${t} PRIVATE ${EFA_LIBRARY})
    endif()
  endif()
endforeach()
if(NCCL_EP_BUILD_EXAMPLES)
  find_package(MPI REQUIRED COMPONENTS CXX)
  add_executable(ep_test ep_test.cu)
  add_executable(ep_bench ep_bench.cu)
  foreach(t ep_test ep_bench)
    target_compile_definitions(${t} PRIVATE MPI_SUPPORT=1 NCCL_CHECK_CUDACC=1)
    target_link_libraries(${t} PRIVATE nccl_ep_shared MPI::MPI_CXX)
  endforeach()
  find_library(CUPTI_LIBRARY cupti HINTS ${CUDAToolkit_LIBRARY_DIR} REQUIRED)
  target_link_libraries(ep_bench PRIVATE ${CUPTI_LIBRARY})
endif()
install(TARGETS nccl_ep_shared nccl_ep_static)
install(FILES include/nccl_ep.h DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})
